description: This file contains the implementation of the PEAR core classes and constants for handling errors and basic functionalities within a PHP project. It defines the PEAR class for error management, including error handling modes, constructors, and shutdown procedures, as well as the PEAR_Error class for representing error objects. Additionally, it sets up several constants, global variables, and auxiliary functions related to the PEAR framework.
external_files: none (all code is contained within this file)

classes.name: PEAR
classes.description: A base class providing error handling, destructor emulation, static property management, extension loading, and other utility functions within the PEAR framework.

classes.name: PEAR_Error
classes.description: A class representing error objects within PEAR, supporting different error modes, callback mechanisms, and debugging features.

methods.name: PEAR
methods.description: Constructor for the PEAR class, registers this object for destructor emulation if applicable.

methods.name: _PEAR
methods.description: Destructor method for the PEAR class, designed for backward compatibility and debugging.

methods.name: getStaticProperty
methods.description: Simulates static properties at the class level, accessible via references.

methods.name: registerShutdownFunc
methods.description: Registers a function to be called during PHP shutdown.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if a given value is a PEAR error object, optionally matching error codes or messages.

methods.name: setErrorHandling
methods.description: Configures how the PEAR class handles errors, setting modes and callback options.

methods.name: expectError
methods.description: Pushes expected error codes onto a stack to handle anticipated errors gracefully.

methods.name: popExpect
methods.description: Removes the most recent expected error codes from the stack.

methods.name: _checkDelExpect
methods.description: Removes specific error codes from the expected errors stack if present.

methods.name: delExpect
methods.description: Deletes specified error codes from the stack, with validation.

methods.name: raiseError
methods.description: Creates and returns an error object based on the current error handling configuration.

methods.name: throwError
methods.description: A simplified interface to raise an error with message, code, and user info.

methods.name: staticPushErrorHandling
methods.description: Pushes current error handling modes onto a global stack and sets new modes.

methods.name: staticPopErrorHandling
methods.description: Restores previous error handling modes from the stack.

methods.name: pushErrorHandling
methods.description: Temporarily overrides error handling modes within the context of an object.

methods.name: popErrorHandling
methods.description: Restores previous error handling modes within an object context.

methods.name: loadExtension
methods.description: Attempts to load a PHP extension in a platform-independent manner.
